Name: Stardew Waystones - Teleport from anywhere to anywhere
Author: holybananapants
Description:
[font=Arial]

Teleport intuitively through Stardew Valley with self-named waystones and build your own travel system.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uUvSqcM.png[/img]
[b][color=#e69138][size=6]🗺️ Features[/size][/color][/b]

[list]
[*][color=#e69138][b]Craftable Waystones:[/b][/color]
[/list] ﻿Craft and place Waystones anywhere you like on your farm or across the valley.

[list]
[*][color=#e69138][b]Custom Naming:[/b][/color]
[/list] ﻿Upon placing a Waystone, you'll be prompted to give it a custom name and confirm by pressing Enter.
﻿Names can be up to 25 characters long. 

[list]
[*][color=#e69138][b]Easy Teleportation:[/b][/color]
[/list] ﻿Clicking on any Waystone opens a selection menu, displaying all your previously placed Waystones.
﻿Simply click on your destination, and you're instantly teleported.

[list]
[*][color=#e69138][b]Edit Mode:[/b][/color]
[/list] ﻿Click the wrench button in the top‑right to enter Edit Mode.
﻿In Edit Mode, drag‑and‑drop sorting has moved here — use the arrow icon to rearrange your list.
﻿You can also rename any Waystone by left‑clicking the pencil icon.

[list]
[*][color=#e69138][b]Protected Placement:[/b][/color]
[/list] ﻿Your Waystones are safe! NPC destruction of player-placed BigCraftables has been disabled,
﻿ensuring your Waystones remain untouched.
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/uUvSqcM.png[/img]
[color=#e69138][size=6]📍 Location Restrictions[/size]
[/color]
[/b]Waystone placement is restricted in certain areas to ensure stable and logical gameplay:

[list]
[*][color=#e69138][b]Bus Stop and Boat Tunnel:[/b] [/color]
[/list] ﻿These locations use their own warp methods and are excluded.

[list]
[*][color=#e69138][b]Mine Shafts and Dungeons:[/b][/color]
[/list] ﻿These areas regenerate upon reloading or entering and are therefore excluded from Waystone placement.

Enjoy easy and intuitive fast travel, customize your teleportation network, and enhance your Stardew Valley
experience with Stardew Waystones!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uUvSqcM.png[/img]
